title: Yemen Forces and Saudi-Led Coalition Claim 378 Houthis Killed, Two Missile Launchers Destroyed
detail: Yemeni government forces and the Saudi-led coalition said 378 Houthi fighters were killed and two missile launchers destroyed, per a Middle East Eye live blog. The figures are claims by the coalition side and have not been independently verified.

media.caption: Yemen forces and Saudi-led coalition claim 378 Houthis killed

title: Houthis Say Saudi Strikes on Yemen Killed Three Children
detail: Houthi authorities said Saudi strikes on Yemen killed three children, per a news aggregator report. The claim comes from one party to the conflict and has not been independently verified; location and date of the strikes were not given in the feed summary.
